desc.ko: 누가 누구를 기다리는지 한 줄씩 — 기다린 시간과 양쪽 쿼리. 막는 쪽 세션부터 본다.
desc.en: One row per wait showing who waits on whom, how long, and both queries. Start from the blocking session.

privilege.ko: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)
privilege.en: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)

queries.body:
SELECT r.session_id AS blocked_session,
       r.blocking_session_id AS blocking_session,
       bs.login_name AS blocking_user,
       r.wait_type AS wait_type,
       r.wait_time / 1000 AS waiting_seconds,
       r.wait_resource AS wait_resource,
       LEFT(wt.text, 200) AS blocked_query,
       LEFT(bt.text, 200) AS blocking_query
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions bs ON bs.session_id = r.blocking_session_id
OUTER APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) wt
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_exec_connections bc ON bc.session_id = r.blocking_session_id
OUTER APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(bc.most_recent_sql_handle) bt
WHERE r.blocking_session_id <> 0
ORDER BY r.wait_time DESC

desc.ko: 세션 {{session_id}}를 끊는다. 진행 중인 트랜잭션은 되돌려진다.
desc.en: Terminates session {{session_id}}. Its open transaction is rolled back.

queries.body: KILL {{session_id}}

desc.ko: 아직 얻지 못하고 기다리는 락 전부.
desc.en: Every lock request that is still waiting.

privilege.ko: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)
privilege.en: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)

queries.body:
SELECT l.request_session_id AS session_id,
       l.resource_type AS lock_type,
       l.request_mode AS lock_mode,
       l.request_status AS lock_status,
       DB_NAME(l.resource_database_id) AS database_name,
       CASE WHEN l.resource_type = 'OBJECT'
            THEN OBJECT_NAME(l.resource_associated_entity_id, l.resource_database_id) END AS object_name,
       l.resource_description AS resource_description
FROM sys.dm_tran_locks l
WHERE l.request_status = 'WAIT'

desc.ko: 세션 {{session_id}}가 잡고 있거나 기다리는 락.
desc.en: Locks held or requested by session {{session_id}}.

privilege.ko: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)
privilege.en: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)

queries.body:
SELECT l.resource_type AS lock_type,
       l.request_mode AS lock_mode,
       l.request_status AS lock_status,
       DB_NAME(l.resource_database_id) AS database_name,
       CASE WHEN l.resource_type = 'OBJECT'
            THEN OBJECT_NAME(l.resource_associated_entity_id, l.resource_database_id) END AS object_name,
       l.resource_description AS resource_description
FROM sys.dm_tran_locks l
WHERE l.request_session_id = {{session_id}}
ORDER BY l.request_status, l.resource_type

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 CHECK 제약과 조건식.
desc.en: Check constraints in schema {{schema}} with their conditions.

queries.body:
SELECT s.name AS schema_name,
       t.name AS table_name,
       cc.name AS constraint_name,
       cc.definition AS definition
FROM sys.check_constraints cc
JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id = cc.parent_object_id
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
WHERE s.name = N'{{schema}}'
ORDER BY 2, 3

title.en: Columns — name, type, null, default, comment

desc.ko: 테이블 {{table}}의 컬럼을 순서대로 보여 준다. 길이·정밀도·생성 열 여부도 함께.
desc.en: Columns of table {{table}} in order, with length, precision and generated-column info.

queries.body:
SELECT c.column_id AS ordinal,
       c.name AS column_name,
       TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS data_type,
       CASE WHEN TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) IN ('nchar', 'nvarchar') AND c.max_length > 0 THEN c.max_length / 2
            ELSE c.max_length END AS max_length,
       c.precision AS numeric_precision,
       c.scale AS numeric_scale,
       CASE WHEN c.is_nullable = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS nullable,
       OBJECT_DEFINITION(c.default_object_id) AS default_value,
       CASE WHEN c.is_computed = 1 THEN 'computed' WHEN c.is_identity = 1 THEN 'identity' END AS generated_kind,
       CAST(ep.value AS nvarchar(4000)) AS comments
FROM sys.columns c
JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id = c.object_id
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id
LEFT JOIN sys.extended_properties ep
       ON ep.class = 1 AND ep.major_id = c.object_id AND ep.minor_id = c.column_id AND ep.name = 'MS_Description'
WHERE s.name = N'{{schema}}' AND o.name = N'{{table}}'
ORDER BY c.column_id

desc.ko: 지금 데이터베이스의 모든 스키마에서 이름에 {{pattern}}이 들어간 컬럼을 찾는다.
desc.en: Finds columns whose name contains {{pattern}} across all schemas of the current database.

queries.body:
SELECT s.name AS schema_name,
       o.name AS table_name,
       c.name AS column_name,
       TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS data_type
FROM sys.columns c
JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id = c.object_id
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id
WHERE o.type IN ('U', 'V') AND c.name LIKE N'%{{pattern}}%'
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}가 참조하거나 참조당하는 외래 키와 갱신·삭제 규칙.
desc.en: Foreign keys referencing or referenced by schema {{schema}}, with update and delete rules.

queries.body:
SELECT ps.name AS schema_name,
       pt.name AS table_name,
       fk.name AS constraint_name,
       STRING_AGG(pc.name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY fkc.constraint_column_id) AS column_names,
       rs.name AS ref_schema,
       rt.name AS ref_table,
       STRING_AGG(rc.name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY fkc.constraint_column_id) AS ref_column_names,
       fk.update_referential_action_desc AS on_update,
       fk.delete_referential_action_desc AS on_delete
FROM sys.foreign_keys fk
JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id
JOIN sys.tables pt ON pt.object_id = fk.parent_object_id
JOIN sys.schemas ps ON ps.schema_id = pt.schema_id
JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id = fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id = fkc.parent_column_id
JOIN sys.tables rt ON rt.object_id = fk.referenced_object_id
JOIN sys.schemas rs ON rs.schema_id = rt.schema_id
JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id = fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id = fkc.referenced_column_id
WHERE ps.name = N'{{schema}}' OR rs.name = N'{{schema}}'
GROUP BY ps.name, pt.name, fk.name, rs.name, rt.name, fk.update_referential_action_desc, fk.delete_referential_action_desc
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 인덱스 — 고유 여부와 컬럼 순서.
desc.en: Indexes in schema {{schema}} with uniqueness and column order.

queries.body:
SELECT s.name AS schema_name,
       t.name AS table_name,
       i.name AS index_name,
       CASE WHEN i.is_unique = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_unique,
       CASE WHEN i.is_primary_key = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_primary,
       i.type_desc AS index_type,
       STRING_AGG(c.name + CASE WHEN ic.is_descending_key = 1 THEN ' DESC' ELSE '' END, ', ')
         WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal) AS column_names
FROM sys.indexes i
JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id = i.object_id
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id AND ic.is_included_column = 0
JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = ic.object_id AND c.column_id = ic.column_id
WHERE s.name = N'{{schema}}' AND i.type > 0
GROUP BY s.name, t.name, i.name, i.is_unique, i.is_primary_key, i.type_desc
ORDER BY 2, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 PK·UK와 그 컬럼.
desc.en: Primary and unique keys in schema {{schema}} with their columns.

queries.body:
SELECT s.name AS schema_name,
       t.name AS table_name,
       k.name AS constraint_name,
       CASE k.type WHEN 'PK' THEN 'PRIMARY KEY' ELSE 'UNIQUE' END AS constraint_type,
       STRING_AGG(c.name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal) AS column_names
FROM sys.key_constraints k
JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id = k.parent_object_id
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id = k.parent_object_id AND ic.index_id = k.unique_index_id
JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = ic.object_id AND c.column_id = ic.column_id
WHERE s.name = N'{{schema}}'
GROUP BY s.name, t.name, k.name, k.type
ORDER BY 2, 4, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 함수·프로시저와 인자·반환 타입.
desc.en: Functions and procedures in schema {{schema}} with arguments and return type.

queries.body:
SELECT s.name AS schema_name,
       o.name AS routine_name,
       o.type_desc AS routine_type,
       o.create_date AS created,
       o.modify_date AS last_altered
FROM sys.objects o
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id
WHERE o.type IN ('P', 'FN', 'IF', 'TF', 'PC', 'FS', 'FT') AND s.name = N'{{schema}}'
ORDER BY 2

desc.ko: 지금 데이터베이스의 스키마와 소유자.
desc.en: Schemas in the current database and their owners.

queries.body:
SELECT s.name AS schema_name,
       p.name AS owner
FROM sys.schemas s
JOIN sys.database_principals p ON p.principal_id = s.principal_id
WHERE s.name NOT IN ('sys', 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA', 'guest') AND s.name NOT LIKE 'db[_]%'
ORDER BY s.name

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 시퀀스와 IDENTITY 열의 현재값.
desc.en: Current values of sequences and IDENTITY columns in schema {{schema}}.

queries.body:
SELECT s.name AS schema_name,
       q.name AS sequence_name,
       'sequence' AS kind,
       CAST(q.current_value AS bigint) AS last_value,
       CAST(q.start_value AS bigint) AS start_value,
       CAST(q.increment AS bigint) AS increment_by
FROM sys.sequences q
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = q.schema_id
WHERE s.name = N'{{schema}}'
UNION ALL
SELECT s.name,
       t.name + N'.' + ic.name,
       'identity',
       CAST(ic.last_value AS bigint),
       CAST(ic.seed_value AS bigint),
       CAST(ic.increment_value AS bigint)
FROM sys.identity_columns ic
JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id = ic.object_id
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
WHERE s.name = N'{{schema}}'
ORDER BY 2

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}에서 설명(MS_Description)이 없는 테이블과 컬럼. 컬럼 칸이 비면 테이블 자체다.
desc.en: Tables and columns in schema {{schema}} without an MS_Description. An empty column cell means the table itself.

queries.body:
SELECT s.name AS schema_name,
       t.name AS table_name,
       CAST(NULL AS sysname) AS column_name
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
WHERE s.name = N'{{schema}}'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.extended_properties ep
                  WHERE ep.class = 1 AND ep.major_id = t.object_id AND ep.minor_id = 0 AND ep.name = 'MS_Description')
UNION ALL
SELECT s.name, t.name, c.name
FROM sys.columns c
JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id = c.object_id
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
WHERE s.name = N'{{schema}}'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.extended_properties ep
                  WHERE ep.class = 1 AND ep.major_id = c.object_id AND ep.minor_id = c.column_id AND ep.name = 'MS_Description')
ORDER BY 2, 3

desc.ko: 지금 데이터베이스에서 데이터·인덱스 크기 합이 큰 테이블 50개.
desc.en: The 50 largest tables in the current database by data plus index size.

queries.body:
SELECT TOP 50
       s.name AS schema_name,
       t.name AS table_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.index_id IN (0, 1) THEN a.used_pages ELSE 0 END) * 8192 AS data_bytes,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.index_id > 1 THEN a.used_pages ELSE 0 END) * 8192 AS index_bytes,
       SUM(a.used_pages) * 8192 AS total_bytes
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id = t.object_id
JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id = i.object_id AND p.index_id = i.index_id
JOIN sys.allocation_units a ON a.container_id = p.partition_id
GROUP BY s.name, t.name
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 테이블과 뷰 — 종류·행 수 추정·코멘트.
desc.en: Tables and views in schema {{schema}} with type, estimated rows and comment.

queries.body:
SELECT s.name AS schema_name,
       o.name AS table_name,
       CASE o.type WHEN 'U' THEN 'table' WHEN 'V' THEN 'view' END AS table_type,
       (SELECT SUM(p.rows) FROM sys.partitions p WHERE p.object_id = o.object_id AND p.index_id IN (0, 1)) AS row_estimate,
       CAST(ep.value AS nvarchar(4000)) AS comments
FROM sys.objects o
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id
LEFT JOIN sys.extended_properties ep
       ON ep.class = 1 AND ep.major_id = o.object_id AND ep.minor_id = 0 AND ep.name = 'MS_Description'
WHERE o.type IN ('U', 'V') AND s.name = N'{{schema}}'
ORDER BY o.name

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 뷰와 정의 SQL.
desc.en: Views in schema {{schema}} and their SQL definitions.

queries.body:
SELECT s.name AS schema_name,
       v.name AS view_name,
       OBJECT_DEFINITION(v.object_id) AS definition
FROM sys.views v
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = v.schema_id
WHERE s.name = N'{{schema}}'
ORDER BY v.name

desc.ko: 버퍼 캐시 적중률과 페이지 기대 수명(초) — 수명이 짧으면 메모리가 모자라다는 뜻이다.
desc.en: Buffer cache hit ratio and page life expectancy in seconds — a short life means memory pressure.

privilege.ko: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)
privilege.en: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)

queries.body:
SELECT CAST(100.0 * a.cntr_value / NULLIF(b.cntr_value, 0) AS decimal(6, 2)) AS hit_percent,
       pl.cntr_value AS page_life_expectancy_s
FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters a
JOIN sys.dm_os_performance_counters b
  ON b.object_name = a.object_name AND b.counter_name = 'Buffer cache hit ratio base'
CROSS JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 cntr_value
            FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters
            WHERE counter_name = 'Page life expectancy' AND object_name LIKE '%Buffer Manager%') pl
WHERE a.counter_name = 'Buffer cache hit ratio' AND a.object_name LIKE '%Buffer Manager%'

desc.ko: 사용자·호스트별 연결 수와 그중 지금 일하는 연결 수.
desc.en: Connection counts per user and host, with how many are active.

privilege.ko: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)
privilege.en: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)

queries.body:
SELECT s.login_name AS user_name,
       s.host_name AS client_host,
       DB_NAME(s.database_id) AS database_name,
       COUNT(*) AS connections,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'running' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active
FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions s
WHERE s.is_user_process = 1
GROUP BY s.login_name, s.host_name, s.database_id
ORDER BY connections DESC

desc.ko: 데이터베이스별 데이터·로그 파일 크기.
desc.en: Data and log file sizes per database.

queries.body:
SELECT DB_NAME(f.database_id) AS database_name,
       f.type_desc AS file_type,
       SUM(CAST(f.size AS bigint)) * 8192 AS total_bytes
FROM sys.master_files f
GROUP BY f.database_id, f.type_desc
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC

desc.ko: {{minutes}}분 넘게 돌고 있는 쿼리. {{minutes}}를 숫자로 바꿔 넣는다.
desc.en: Queries running longer than {{minutes}} minutes. Replace {{minutes}} with a number.

privilege.ko: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)
privilege.en: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)

queries.body:
SELECT r.session_id AS session_id,
       s.login_name AS user_name,
       r.status AS state,
       r.start_time AS query_started,
       DATEDIFF(SECOND, r.start_time, SYSDATETIME()) AS running_seconds,
       r.wait_type AS wait_type,
       LEFT(t.text, 500) AS query_text
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) t
WHERE s.is_user_process = 1 AND r.session_id <> @@SPID
  AND r.start_time < DATEADD(MINUTE, -{{minutes}}, SYSDATETIME())
ORDER BY r.start_time

desc.ko: 메모리·연결·타임아웃 등 자주 보는 서버 설정값.
desc.en: Commonly checked server settings such as memory, connections and timeouts.

queries.body:
SELECT c.name AS setting_name,
       CAST(c.value_in_use AS nvarchar(100)) AS value,
       CAST(c.description AS nvarchar(255)) AS description
FROM sys.configurations c
WHERE c.name IN ('max server memory (MB)', 'min server memory (MB)', 'max degree of parallelism', 'cost threshold for parallelism',
                 'optimize for ad hoc workloads', 'remote admin connections', 'backup compression default', 'user connections')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'collation', CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('Collation') AS nvarchar(100)), N'server collation'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'edition', CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('Edition') AS nvarchar(100)), N'edition'
ORDER BY 1

desc.ko: 연결된 세션 — 사용자·호스트·프로그램·상태·접속 시각·지금 쿼리 앞부분.
desc.en: Connected sessions with user, host, program, state, connect time and the start of the current query.

privilege.ko: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)
privilege.en: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)

queries.body:
SELECT s.session_id AS session_id,
       s.login_name AS user_name,
       s.host_name AS client_host,
       s.program_name AS program,
       s.status AS state,
       s.login_time AS connected_at,
       r.start_time AS query_started,
       r.wait_type AS wait_type,
       r.blocking_session_id AS blocked_by,
       DB_NAME(s.database_id) AS database_name,
       LEFT(t.text, 200) AS query_text
FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions s
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_exec_requests r ON r.session_id = s.session_id
OUTER APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) t
WHERE s.is_user_process = 1
ORDER BY s.login_time

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 테이블별 읽기(찾기·훑기)·쓰기 횟수와 마지막 사용·통계 갱신 시각(서버가 켜진 뒤).
desc.en: Per-table seeks, scans and writes in schema {{schema}} with last use and statistics update (since startup).

privilege.ko: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)
privilege.en: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)

queries.body:
SELECT s.name AS schema_name,
       t.name AS table_name,
       SUM(u.user_seeks) AS index_seeks,
       SUM(u.user_scans) AS scans,
       SUM(u.user_lookups) AS lookups,
       SUM(u.user_updates) AS writes,
       MAX(u.last_user_seek) AS last_seek,
       MAX(u.last_user_scan) AS last_scan,
       MAX(u.last_user_update) AS last_update,
       STATS_DATE(t.object_id, 1) AS last_stats_update
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats u ON u.object_id = t.object_id AND u.database_id = DB_ID()
WHERE s.name = N'{{schema}}'
GROUP BY s.name, t.name, t.object_id
ORDER BY t.name

desc.ko: 계획 캐시에 남은 쿼리 중 누적 실행 시간이 큰 20개. 서버를 다시 켜거나 캐시가 비면 사라진다.
desc.en: The 20 cached statements with the largest total elapsed time. Lost on restart or cache flush.

privilege.ko: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)
privilege.en: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+: VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)

queries.body:
SELECT TOP 20
       qs.execution_count AS calls,
       qs.total_elapsed_time / 1000 AS total_ms,
       qs.total_elapsed_time / qs.execution_count / 1000.0 AS mean_ms,
       qs.total_rows AS rows_returned,
       LEFT(t.text, 300) AS query_text
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats qs
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) t
ORDER BY qs.total_elapsed_time DESC

desc.ko: 사용자 {{user}}의 비밀번호를 {{password}}로 바꾼다.
desc.en: Changes the password of user {{user}} to {{password}}.

queries.body: ALTER LOGIN [{{user}}] WITH PASSWORD = N'{{password}}'

desc.ko: 로그인 {{user}}를 만들고 지금 데이터베이스에 같은 이름의 사용자를 붙인다. 두 문장 — 스크립트로 실행한다.
desc.en: Creates login {{user}} and a matching user in the current database. Two statements — run as a script.

queries.body:
CREATE LOGIN [{{user}}] WITH PASSWORD = N'{{password}}';
CREATE USER [{{user}}] FOR LOGIN [{{user}}];

desc.ko: 지금 데이터베이스의 사용자 {{user}}와 서버 로그인을 지운다. 다른 데이터베이스에 같은 사용자가 있으면 거기서도 먼저 지운다.
desc.en: Drops user {{user}} in the current database and the server login. Drop the user from other databases first.

queries.body:
DROP USER [{{user}}];
DROP LOGIN [{{user}}];

desc.ko: 사용자 {{user}}에게 스키마 {{schema}}의 지금·앞으로 만들 테이블 읽기 권한을 준다.
desc.en: Grants user {{user}} read on current and future tables in schema {{schema}}.

queries.body: GRANT SELECT ON SCHEMA::[{{schema}}] TO [{{user}}]

desc.ko: 서버 로그인(SQL·Windows)과 사용 안 함·잠김·비밀번호 바꾼 때.
desc.en: Server logins (SQL and Windows) with disabled, locked and password change time.

queries.body:
SELECT p.name AS user_name,
       p.type_desc AS user_type,
       p.is_disabled AS is_disabled,
       CAST(LOGINPROPERTY(p.name, 'IsLocked') AS int) AS is_locked,
       CAST(LOGINPROPERTY(p.name, 'PasswordLastSetTime') AS datetime2) AS password_changed_at,
       l.is_expiration_checked AS expiration_checked,
       p.create_date AS created,
       p.modify_date AS modified
FROM sys.server_principals p
LEFT JOIN sys.sql_logins l ON l.principal_id = p.principal_id
WHERE p.type IN ('S', 'U', 'G') AND p.name NOT LIKE '##%'
ORDER BY p.name

desc.ko: 로그인 {{user}}를 사용 안 함으로 둔다 — 새로 접속하지 못한다.
desc.en: Disables login {{user}} so it can no longer connect.

queries.body: ALTER LOGIN [{{user}}] DISABLE

title.en: Who can do what on a table

desc.ko: 테이블 {{table}}에 권한을 받은 사용자와 그 권한.
desc.en: Users granted privileges on table {{table}} and what they can do.

queries.body:
SELECT pr.name AS grantee,
       pe.state_desc AS state,
       pe.permission_name AS privilege,
       OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(pe.major_id) AS schema_name,
       OBJECT_NAME(pe.major_id) AS object_name
FROM sys.database_permissions pe
JOIN sys.database_principals pr ON pr.principal_id = pe.grantee_principal_id
WHERE pe.class = 1 AND pe.major_id = OBJECT_ID(N'{{schema}}.{{table}}')
ORDER BY 1, 3

desc.ko: 「스키마 읽기 권한 주기」로 준 권한을 되돌린다.
desc.en: Reverts the grant made by "Grant read on a schema".

queries.body: REVOKE SELECT ON SCHEMA::[{{schema}}] FROM [{{user}}]

desc.ko: 사용 안 함으로 둔 로그인 {{user}}를 다시 쓴다.
desc.en: Enables login {{user}} again.

queries.body: ALTER LOGIN [{{user}}] ENABLE

desc.ko: 지금 데이터베이스에서 사용자 {{user}}가 받은 권한과 속한 데이터베이스 롤.
desc.en: Permissions and database role memberships of user {{user}} in the current database.

queries.body:
SELECT pr.name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS user_name,
       pe.state_desc COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS state,
       pe.permission_name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS privilege,
       pe.class_desc COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS object_type,
       CASE pe.class WHEN 1 THEN OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(pe.major_id) + N'.' + OBJECT_NAME(pe.major_id)
                     WHEN 3 THEN SCHEMA_NAME(pe.major_id)
                     WHEN 0 THEN DB_NAME() END AS object_name
FROM sys.database_permissions pe
JOIN sys.database_principals pr ON pr.principal_id = pe.grantee_principal_id
WHERE pr.name = N'{{user}}'
UNION ALL
SELECT m.name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N'MEMBER', r.name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N'ROLE', NULL
FROM sys.database_role_members rm
JOIN sys.database_principals r ON r.principal_id = rm.role_principal_id
JOIN sys.database_principals m ON m.principal_id = rm.member_principal_id
WHERE m.name = N'{{user}}'
ORDER BY 4, 5, 3

desc.ko: InnoDB 행 락을 누가 누구를 기다리는지 — 기다린 시간·양쪽 쿼리·끊는 문장. 막는 쪽 세션부터 본다.
desc.en: Who waits on whom for InnoDB row locks, with wait time, both queries and the kill statement. Start from the blocking session.

queries.body:
SELECT w.waiting_pid AS blocked_session,
       w.wait_age_secs AS waiting_seconds,
       w.waiting_query AS blocked_query,
       w.locked_table AS object_name,
       w.blocking_pid AS blocking_session,
       w.blocking_query AS blocking_query,
       w.sql_kill_blocking_connection AS kill_hint
FROM sys.innodb_lock_waits w
ORDER BY w.wait_age_secs DESC

desc.ko: 세션 {{session_id}}의 지금 쿼리만 멈춘다. 세션(연결)은 남는다.
desc.en: Stops only the current query of session {{session_id}}. The session stays connected.

queries.body: KILL QUERY {{session_id}}

desc.ko: 세션 {{session_id}}를 끊는다. 진행 중인 트랜잭션은 되돌려진다.
desc.en: Terminates session {{session_id}}. Its open transaction is rolled back.

queries.body: KILL {{session_id}}

desc.ko: 아직 얻지 못하고 기다리는 락 전부.
desc.en: Every lock request that is still waiting.

queries.body:
SELECT t.processlist_id AS session_id,
       l.object_schema AS schema_name,
       l.object_name AS object_name,
       l.lock_type AS lock_type,
       l.lock_mode AS lock_mode,
       l.lock_status AS lock_status,
       l.lock_data AS lock_data
FROM performance_schema.data_locks l
JOIN performance_schema.threads t ON t.thread_id = l.thread_id
WHERE l.lock_status = 'WAITING'

desc.ko: 세션(연결 번호) {{session_id}}가 잡고 있거나 기다리는 InnoDB 락.
desc.en: InnoDB locks held or requested by session (connection id) {{session_id}}.

queries.body:
SELECT l.object_schema AS schema_name,
       l.object_name AS object_name,
       l.index_name AS index_name,
       l.lock_type AS lock_type,
       l.lock_mode AS lock_mode,
       l.lock_status AS lock_status,
       l.lock_data AS lock_data
FROM performance_schema.data_locks l
JOIN performance_schema.threads t ON t.thread_id = l.thread_id
WHERE t.processlist_id = {{session_id}}

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 CHECK 제약과 조건식. CHECK 제약 표는 MySQL 8.0.16부터 있다.
desc.en: Check constraints in schema {{schema}}. The check constraint view exists from MySQL 8.0.16.

queries.body:
SELECT tc.table_schema AS schema_name,
       tc.table_name AS table_name,
       cc.constraint_name AS constraint_name,
       cc.check_clause AS definition
FROM information_schema.check_constraints cc
JOIN information_schema.table_constraints tc
  ON tc.constraint_schema = cc.constraint_schema AND tc.constraint_name = cc.constraint_name AND tc.constraint_type = 'CHECK'
WHERE cc.constraint_schema = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY 2, 3

title.en: Columns — name, type, null, default, comment

desc.ko: 테이블 {{table}}의 컬럼을 순서대로 보여 준다. 길이·정밀도·생성 열 여부도 함께.
desc.en: Columns of table {{table}} in order, with length, precision and generated-column info.

queries.body:
SELECT c.ordinal_position AS ordinal,
       c.column_name AS column_name,
       c.column_type AS data_type,
       c.character_maximum_length AS max_length,
       c.numeric_precision AS numeric_precision,
       c.numeric_scale AS numeric_scale,
       c.is_nullable AS nullable,
       c.column_default AS default_value,
       CASE WHEN c.extra LIKE '%GENERATED%' AND c.extra <> 'DEFAULT_GENERATED' THEN c.extra
            WHEN c.extra LIKE '%auto_increment%' THEN 'auto_increment' END AS generated_kind,
       c.generation_expression AS generation_expression,
       c.column_comment AS comments
FROM information_schema.columns c
WHERE c.table_schema = '{{schema}}' AND c.table_name = '{{table}}'
ORDER BY c.ordinal_position

desc.ko: 모든 스키마에서 이름에 {{pattern}}이 들어간 컬럼을 찾는다.
desc.en: Finds columns whose name contains {{pattern}} across all schemas.

queries.body:
SELECT c.table_schema AS schema_name,
       c.table_name AS table_name,
       c.column_name AS column_name,
       c.column_type AS data_type
FROM information_schema.columns c
WHERE c.column_name LIKE '%{{pattern}}%'
  AND c.table_schema NOT IN ('mysql', 'sys', 'performance_schema', 'information_schema')
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}가 참조하거나 참조당하는 외래 키와 갱신·삭제 규칙.
desc.en: Foreign keys referencing or referenced by schema {{schema}}, with update and delete rules.

queries.body:
SELECT k.table_schema AS schema_name,
       k.table_name AS table_name,
       k.constraint_name AS constraint_name,
       GROUP_CONCAT(k.column_name ORDER BY k.ordinal_position SEPARATOR ', ') AS column_names,
       k.referenced_table_schema AS ref_schema,
       k.referenced_table_name AS ref_table,
       GROUP_CONCAT(k.referenced_column_name ORDER BY k.ordinal_position SEPARATOR ', ') AS ref_column_names,
       r.update_rule AS on_update,
       r.delete_rule AS on_delete
FROM information_schema.key_column_usage k
JOIN information_schema.referential_constraints r
  ON r.constraint_schema = k.constraint_schema AND r.constraint_name = k.constraint_name AND r.table_name = k.table_name
WHERE k.referenced_table_name IS NOT NULL
  AND (k.table_schema = '{{schema}}' OR k.referenced_table_schema = '{{schema}}')
GROUP BY k.table_schema, k.table_name, k.constraint_name, k.referenced_table_schema, k.referenced_table_name,
         r.update_rule, r.delete_rule
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 인덱스 — 고유 여부와 컬럼 순서.
desc.en: Indexes in schema {{schema}} with uniqueness and column order.

queries.body:
SELECT s.table_schema AS schema_name,
       s.table_name AS table_name,
       s.index_name AS index_name,
       CASE WHEN s.non_unique = 0 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_unique,
       CASE WHEN s.index_name = 'PRIMARY' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_primary,
       s.index_type AS index_type,
       GROUP_CONCAT(s.column_name ORDER BY s.seq_in_index SEPARATOR ', ') AS column_names
FROM information_schema.statistics s
WHERE s.table_schema = '{{schema}}'
GROUP BY s.table_schema, s.table_name, s.index_name, s.non_unique, s.index_type
ORDER BY 2, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 PK·UK와 그 컬럼.
desc.en: Primary and unique keys in schema {{schema}} with their columns.

queries.body:
SELECT tc.table_schema AS schema_name,
       tc.table_name AS table_name,
       tc.constraint_name AS constraint_name,
       tc.constraint_type AS constraint_type,
       GROUP_CONCAT(k.column_name ORDER BY k.ordinal_position SEPARATOR ', ') AS column_names
FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage k
  ON k.constraint_schema = tc.constraint_schema AND k.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name AND k.table_name = tc.table_name
WHERE tc.constraint_type IN ('PRIMARY KEY', 'UNIQUE') AND tc.table_schema = '{{schema}}'
GROUP BY tc.table_schema, tc.table_name, tc.constraint_name, tc.constraint_type
ORDER BY 2, 4, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 함수·프로시저와 인자·반환 타입.
desc.en: Functions and procedures in schema {{schema}} with arguments and return type.

queries.body:
SELECT r.routine_schema AS schema_name,
       r.routine_name AS routine_name,
       r.routine_type AS routine_type,
       r.dtd_identifier AS returns,
       r.created AS created,
       r.last_altered AS last_altered
FROM information_schema.routines r
WHERE r.routine_schema = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY 2

desc.ko: 데이터베이스와 기본 문자 집합·정렬. MySQL은 스키마에 소유자가 없다.
desc.en: Databases with default character set and collation. MySQL schemas have no owner.

queries.body:
SELECT s.schema_name AS schema_name,
       s.default_character_set_name AS charset,
       s.default_collation_name AS collation_name
FROM information_schema.schemata s
ORDER BY s.schema_name

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}에서 AUTO_INCREMENT가 있는 테이블과 다음 값. 통계 캐시 탓에 조금 늦게 바뀔 수 있다.
desc.en: Tables with AUTO_INCREMENT in schema {{schema}} and their next value (may lag due to statistics caching).

queries.body:
SELECT t.table_schema AS schema_name,
       t.table_name AS table_name,
       t.auto_increment AS next_value
FROM information_schema.tables t
WHERE t.table_schema = '{{schema}}' AND t.auto_increment IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY t.table_name

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}에서 코멘트가 비어 있는 테이블과 컬럼. 컬럼 칸이 비면 테이블 자체다.
desc.en: Tables and columns in schema {{schema}} with no comment. An empty column cell means the table itself.

queries.body:
SELECT t.table_schema AS schema_name,
       t.table_name AS table_name,
       NULL AS column_name
FROM information_schema.tables t
WHERE t.table_schema = '{{schema}}' AND t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE' AND t.table_comment = ''
UNION ALL
SELECT c.table_schema, c.table_name, c.column_name
FROM information_schema.columns c
JOIN information_schema.tables t ON t.table_schema = c.table_schema AND t.table_name = c.table_name
WHERE c.table_schema = '{{schema}}' AND t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE' AND c.column_comment = ''
ORDER BY 2, 3

desc.ko: 데이터·인덱스 크기 합이 큰 순서로 50개. 값은 통계 기준 추정치다.
desc.en: The 50 largest tables by data plus index size (statistics-based estimates).

queries.body:
SELECT t.table_schema AS schema_name,
       t.table_name AS table_name,
       t.data_length AS data_bytes,
       t.index_length AS index_bytes,
       t.data_length + t.index_length AS total_bytes
FROM information_schema.tables t
WHERE t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
  AND t.table_schema NOT IN ('mysql', 'sys', 'performance_schema', 'information_schema')
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC
LIMIT 50

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 테이블과 뷰 — 종류·행 수 추정·코멘트.
desc.en: Tables and views in schema {{schema}} with type, estimated rows and comment.

queries.body:
SELECT t.table_schema AS schema_name,
       t.table_name AS table_name,
       t.table_type AS table_type,
       t.table_rows AS row_estimate,
       t.engine AS engine,
       t.table_comment AS comments
FROM information_schema.tables t
WHERE t.table_schema = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY t.table_name

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 뷰와 정의 SQL.
desc.en: Views in schema {{schema}} and their SQL definitions.

queries.body:
SELECT v.table_schema AS schema_name,
       v.table_name AS view_name,
       v.view_definition AS definition
FROM information_schema.views v
WHERE v.table_schema = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY v.table_name

desc.ko: InnoDB 버퍼 풀에서 디스크를 읽지 않고 찾은 비율.
desc.en: The share of InnoDB buffer pool reads served from memory.

queries.body:
SELECT r.variable_value AS read_requests,
       d.variable_value AS disk_reads,
       ROUND(100 * (1 - d.variable_value / NULLIF(r.variable_value, 0)), 2) AS hit_percent
FROM performance_schema.global_status r
JOIN performance_schema.global_status d ON d.variable_name = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_reads'
WHERE r.variable_name = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests'

desc.ko: 사용자·호스트별 연결 수와 그중 지금 일하는 연결 수.
desc.en: Connection counts per user and host, with how many are active.

queries.body:
SELECT p.user AS user_name,
       SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.host, ':', 1) AS client_host,
       COUNT(*) AS connections,
       SUM(p.command <> 'Sleep') AS active
FROM information_schema.processlist p
GROUP BY p.user, SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.host, ':', 1)
ORDER BY connections DESC

desc.ko: 데이터베이스(스키마)별 데이터·인덱스 크기와 남은 자리. 통계 기준 추정치다.
desc.en: Data plus index size and free space per database (statistics-based estimates).

queries.body:
SELECT t.table_schema AS database_name,
       SUM(t.data_length + t.index_length) AS total_bytes,
       SUM(t.data_free) AS free_bytes
FROM information_schema.tables t
GROUP BY t.table_schema
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC

desc.ko: {{minutes}}분 넘게 돌고 있는 쿼리. {{minutes}}를 숫자로 바꿔 넣는다.
desc.en: Queries running longer than {{minutes}} minutes. Replace {{minutes}} with a number.

queries.body:
SELECT p.id AS session_id,
       p.user AS user_name,
       p.db AS database_name,
       p.time AS running_seconds,
       p.state AS wait_event,
       LEFT(p.info, 500) AS query_text
FROM information_schema.processlist p
WHERE p.command <> 'Sleep' AND p.id <> CONNECTION_ID() AND p.time >= {{minutes}} * 60
ORDER BY p.time DESC

desc.ko: 이 서버가 레플리카일 때 복제 상태와 지연(Seconds_Behind_Source). 레플리카가 아니면 행이 없다.
desc.en: Replication state and lag (Seconds_Behind_Source) when this server is a replica. Returns nothing otherwise.

queries.body: SHOW REPLICA STATUS

desc.ko: 메모리·연결·타임아웃 등 자주 보는 서버 설정값.
desc.en: Commonly checked server settings such as memory, connections and timeouts.

queries.body:
SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES
WHERE Variable_name IN ('max_connections', 'innodb_buffer_pool_size', 'innodb_redo_log_capacity', 'innodb_log_file_size',
                        'innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit', 'sync_binlog', 'long_query_time', 'slow_query_log',
                        'wait_timeout', 'lock_wait_timeout', 'innodb_lock_wait_timeout', 'sql_mode',
                        'character_set_server', 'collation_server', 'time_zone', 'transaction_isolation', 'binlog_format', 'server_id')

desc.ko: 연결된 세션 — 사용자·호스트·프로그램·상태·접속 시각·지금 쿼리 앞부분.
desc.en: Connected sessions with user, host, program, state, connect time and the start of the current query.

queries.body:
SELECT p.id AS session_id,
       p.user AS user_name,
       p.host AS client_host,
       p.db AS database_name,
       p.command AS state,
       p.time AS running_seconds,
       p.state AS wait_event,
       LEFT(p.info, 200) AS query_text
FROM information_schema.processlist p
ORDER BY p.time DESC

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 테이블별 읽기·쓰기 횟수(서버가 켜진 뒤 누적).
desc.en: Per-table read and write counts in schema {{schema}} since the server started.

queries.body:
SELECT s.object_schema AS schema_name,
       s.object_name AS table_name,
       s.count_read AS read_ops,
       s.count_write AS write_ops,
       s.count_fetch AS fetched_rows,
       s.count_insert AS inserted,
       s.count_update AS updated,
       s.count_delete AS deleted
FROM performance_schema.table_io_waits_summary_by_table s
WHERE s.object_schema = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY s.count_star DESC

desc.ko: 서버가 모아 둔 쿼리 통계에서 누적 실행 시간이 큰 순서로 20개.
desc.en: The 20 statements with the largest total execution time from server statistics.

queries.body:
SELECT d.count_star AS calls,
       ROUND(d.sum_timer_wait / 1000000000, 1) AS total_ms,
       ROUND(d.avg_timer_wait / 1000000000, 2) AS mean_ms,
       d.sum_rows_sent AS rows_returned,
       d.schema_name AS schema_name,
       LEFT(d.digest_text, 300) AS query_text
FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest d
ORDER BY d.sum_timer_wait DESC
LIMIT 20

desc.ko: 사용자 {{user}}의 비밀번호를 {{password}}로 바꾼다.
desc.en: Changes the password of user {{user}} to {{password}}.

queries.body: ALTER USER '{{user}}'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY '{{password}}'

desc.ko: 계정 '{{user}}'@'%'를 만든다. 특정 호스트에서만 받으려면 '%'를 바꾼다.
desc.en: Creates account '{{user}}'@'%'. Change '%' to allow only a specific host.

queries.body: CREATE USER '{{user}}'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY '{{password}}'

desc.ko: 계정 '{{user}}'@'%'를 지운다. 받은 권한도 같이 사라진다.
desc.en: Drops account '{{user}}'@'%' together with its grants.

queries.body: DROP USER '{{user}}'@'%'

desc.ko: 사용자 {{user}}에게 스키마 {{schema}}의 테이블 읽기 권한을 준다.
desc.en: Grants user {{user}} read access to the tables in schema {{schema}}.

queries.body: GRANT SELECT, SHOW VIEW ON {{schema}}.* TO '{{user}}'@'%'

desc.ko: 계정(사용자@호스트)과 잠김·비밀번호 만료·인증 방식.
desc.en: Accounts (user@host) with lock state, password expiry and auth plugin.

queries.body:
SELECT u.user AS user_name,
       u.host AS client_host,
       u.account_locked AS locked,
       u.password_expired AS password_expired,
       u.password_last_changed AS password_changed_at,
       u.plugin AS auth_plugin
FROM mysql.user u
ORDER BY u.user, u.host

desc.ko: 사용자 {{user}}가 더는 접속하지 못하게 한다. 이미 붙은 세션은 그대로다.
desc.en: Prevents user {{user}} from connecting. Existing sessions stay.

queries.body: ALTER USER '{{user}}'@'%' ACCOUNT LOCK

title.en: Who can do what on a table

desc.ko: 테이블 {{table}}에 직접 받은 권한과 스키마 {{schema}} 전체(*)에 받은 권한.
desc.en: Privileges granted on table {{table}} and on all of schema {{schema}} (*).

queries.body:
SELECT p.grantee AS grantee,
       p.table_schema AS schema_name,
       p.table_name AS object_name,
       GROUP_CONCAT(p.privilege_type ORDER BY p.privilege_type SEPARATOR ', ') AS privileges
FROM information_schema.table_privileges p
WHERE p.table_schema = '{{schema}}' AND p.table_name = '{{table}}'
GROUP BY p.grantee, p.table_schema, p.table_name
UNION ALL
SELECT s.grantee, s.table_schema, '*', GROUP_CONCAT(s.privilege_type ORDER BY s.privilege_type SEPARATOR ', ')
FROM information_schema.schema_privileges s
WHERE s.table_schema = '{{schema}}'
GROUP BY s.grantee, s.table_schema
ORDER BY 1, 3

desc.ko: 「스키마 읽기 권한 주기」로 준 권한을 되돌린다.
desc.en: Reverts the grant made by "Grant read on a schema".

queries.body: REVOKE SELECT, SHOW VIEW ON {{schema}}.* FROM '{{user}}'@'%'

desc.ko: 잠근 사용자 {{user}}가 다시 접속할 수 있게 한다.
desc.en: Lets locked user {{user}} connect again.

queries.body: ALTER USER '{{user}}'@'%' ACCOUNT UNLOCK

desc.ko: 계정 '{{user}}'@'%'의 GRANT 문 전부. 호스트가 다르면 '%'를 바꾼다.
desc.en: Every GRANT statement for account '{{user}}'@'%'. Change '%' for another host.

queries.body: SHOW GRANTS FOR '{{user}}'@'%'

desc.ko: 누가 누구를 기다리는지 한 줄씩 — 기다린 시간과 양쪽 쿼리. 막는 쪽 세션부터 본다.
desc.en: One row per wait showing who waits on whom, how long, and both queries. Start from the blocking session.

queries.body:
SELECT w.sid AS blocked_session,
       w.serial# AS blocked_serial,
       w.username AS blocked_user,
       ROUND(w.wait_time_micro / 1000000) AS waiting_seconds,
       w.event AS wait_event,
       b.sid AS blocking_session,
       b.serial# AS blocking_serial,
       b.username AS blocking_user,
       b.status AS blocking_state,
       SUBSTR(q.sql_text, 1, 200) AS blocked_query
FROM v$session w
JOIN v$session b ON b.sid = w.blocking_session
LEFT JOIN v$sql q ON q.sql_id = w.sql_id AND q.child_number = w.sql_child_number
WHERE w.blocking_session IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY w.wait_time_micro DESC

desc.ko: 세션 {{session_id}}(시리얼 {{serial_no}})의 지금 쿼리만 멈춘다. 18c부터 된다.
desc.en: Stops only the current query of session {{session_id}} (serial {{serial_no}}). Available from 18c.

queries.body: ALTER SYSTEM CANCEL SQL '{{session_id}}, {{serial_no}}'

desc.ko: 세션 {{session_id}}(시리얼 {{serial_no}})를 끊는다. 진행 중인 트랜잭션은 되돌려진다. ORA-00031(끊길 예정으로 표시)이 나와도 곧 끊긴다.
desc.en: Terminates session {{session_id}} (serial {{serial_no}}). Its open transaction is rolled back. ORA-00031 (marked for kill) means it is ending.

queries.body: ALTER SYSTEM KILL SESSION '{{session_id}},{{serial_no}}' IMMEDIATE

desc.ko: 아직 얻지 못하고 기다리는 락 — 행 락(TX)은 막는 세션을 「막고 있는 세션」에서 본다.
desc.en: Lock requests still waiting. For row locks (TX) see the blocker in "Blocking and blocked sessions".

queries.body:
SELECT l.sid AS session_id,
       s.username AS user_name,
       l.type AS lock_type,
       l.lmode AS held_mode,
       l.request AS requested_mode,
       l.ctime AS seconds_in_mode,
       o.owner || '.' || o.object_name AS object_name
FROM v$lock l
JOIN v$session s ON s.sid = l.sid
LEFT JOIN dba_objects o ON o.object_id = l.id1 AND l.type = 'TM'
WHERE l.request > 0
ORDER BY l.ctime DESC

desc.ko: 세션(SID) {{session_id}}가 잡고 있거나 기다리는 락. blocking_others가 1이면 이 락이 다른 세션을 막고 있다.
desc.en: Locks held or requested by session (SID) {{session_id}}. blocking_others = 1 means this lock blocks others.

queries.body:
SELECT l.type AS lock_type,
       l.lmode AS held_mode,
       l.request AS requested_mode,
       l.ctime AS seconds_in_mode,
       l.block AS blocking_others,
       o.owner || '.' || o.object_name AS object_name
FROM v$lock l
LEFT JOIN dba_objects o ON o.object_id = l.id1 AND l.type = 'TM'
WHERE l.sid = {{session_id}}
ORDER BY l.type

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 CHECK 제약. NOT NULL도 CHECK로 잡혀 SYS_C… 이름으로 함께 나온다(name_kind가 GENERATED NAME).
desc.en: Check constraints in schema {{schema}}. NOT NULL constraints also appear as SYS_C… (name_kind GENERATED NAME).

queries.body:
SELECT k.owner AS schema_name,
       k.table_name AS table_name,
       k.constraint_name AS constraint_name,
       k.search_condition AS definition,
       k.generated AS name_kind
FROM all_constraints k
WHERE k.constraint_type = 'C' AND k.owner = '{{schema}}' AND k.table_name NOT LIKE 'BIN$%'
ORDER BY 2, 3

title.en: Columns — name, type, null, default, comment

desc.ko: 테이블 {{table}}의 컬럼을 순서대로 — 정밀도는 data_precision(NUMBER의 길이 22는 정밀도가 아니다), 가상 열도 보인다.
desc.en: Columns of table {{table}} in order. Precision comes from data_precision (NUMBER length 22 is not precision); virtual columns are included.

queries.body:
SELECT c.column_id AS ordinal,
       c.column_name AS column_name,
       c.data_type AS data_type,
       c.char_length AS max_length,
       c.data_precision AS numeric_precision,
       c.data_scale AS numeric_scale,
       CASE c.nullable WHEN 'Y' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS nullable,
       c.data_default AS default_value,
       CASE WHEN c.virtual_column = 'YES' THEN 'virtual' END AS generated_kind,
       m.comments AS comments
FROM all_tab_cols c
LEFT JOIN all_col_comments m
       ON m.owner = c.owner AND m.table_name = c.table_name AND m.column_name = c.column_name
WHERE c.owner = '{{schema}}' AND c.table_name = '{{table}}' AND c.hidden_column = 'NO'
ORDER BY c.column_id

desc.ko: 모든 스키마에서 이름에 {{pattern}}이 들어간 컬럼을 찾는다.
desc.en: Finds columns whose name contains {{pattern}} across all schemas.

queries.body:
SELECT c.owner AS schema_name,
       c.table_name AS table_name,
       c.column_name AS column_name,
       c.data_type AS data_type
FROM all_tab_columns c
WHERE c.column_name LIKE UPPER('%{{pattern}}%')
  AND c.owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'OLAPSYS', 'WMSYS', 'LBACSYS',
                      'DVSYS', 'AUDSYS', 'GSMADMIN_INTERNAL', 'OJVMSYS', 'DBSNMP', 'APPQOSSYS', 'OUTLN', 'ORDDATA')
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}가 참조하거나 참조당하는 외래 키. Oracle에는 ON UPDATE가 없다.
desc.en: Foreign keys referencing or referenced by schema {{schema}}. Oracle has no ON UPDATE.

queries.body:
SELECT k.owner AS schema_name,
       k.table_name AS table_name,
       k.constraint_name AS constraint_name,
       (SELECT LISTAGG(cc.column_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cc.position)
          FROM all_cons_columns cc WHERE cc.owner = k.owner AND cc.constraint_name = k.constraint_name) AS column_names,
       r.owner AS ref_schema,
       r.table_name AS ref_table,
       (SELECT LISTAGG(rc.column_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rc.position)
          FROM all_cons_columns rc WHERE rc.owner = r.owner AND rc.constraint_name = r.constraint_name) AS ref_column_names,
       'NO ACTION' AS on_update,
       k.delete_rule AS on_delete
FROM all_constraints k
JOIN all_constraints r ON r.owner = k.r_owner AND r.constraint_name = k.r_constraint_name
WHERE k.constraint_type = 'R' AND (k.owner = '{{schema}}' OR r.owner = '{{schema}}')
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 인덱스 — 고유 여부와 컬럼 순서.
desc.en: Indexes in schema {{schema}} with uniqueness and column order.

queries.body:
SELECT i.table_owner AS schema_name,
       i.table_name AS table_name,
       i.index_name AS index_name,
       CASE i.uniqueness WHEN 'UNIQUE' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_unique,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM all_constraints k
                         WHERE k.owner = i.table_owner AND k.index_name = i.index_name AND k.constraint_type = 'P')
            THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_primary,
       i.index_type AS index_type,
       (SELECT LISTAGG(ic.column_name || CASE WHEN ic.descend = 'DESC' THEN ' DESC' END, ', ')
                 WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ic.column_position)
          FROM all_ind_columns ic WHERE ic.index_owner = i.owner AND ic.index_name = i.index_name) AS column_names
FROM all_indexes i
WHERE i.table_owner = '{{schema}}' AND i.table_name NOT LIKE 'BIN$%'
ORDER BY 2, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 PK·UK와 그 컬럼.
desc.en: Primary and unique keys in schema {{schema}} with their columns.

queries.body:
SELECT k.owner AS schema_name,
       k.table_name AS table_name,
       k.constraint_name AS constraint_name,
       CASE k.constraint_type WHEN 'P' THEN 'PRIMARY KEY' ELSE 'UNIQUE' END AS constraint_type,
       LISTAGG(cc.column_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cc.position) AS column_names
FROM all_constraints k
JOIN all_cons_columns cc
  ON cc.owner = k.owner AND cc.constraint_name = k.constraint_name AND cc.table_name = k.table_name
WHERE k.constraint_type IN ('P', 'U') AND k.owner = '{{schema}}' AND k.table_name NOT LIKE 'BIN$%'
GROUP BY k.owner, k.table_name, k.constraint_name, k.constraint_type
ORDER BY 2, 4, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 함수·프로시저·패키지와 컴파일 상태(INVALID면 다시 컴파일해야 한다).
desc.en: Functions, procedures and packages in schema {{schema}} with compile status (INVALID needs recompiling).

queries.body:
SELECT o.owner AS schema_name,
       o.object_name AS routine_name,
       LOWER(o.object_type) AS routine_type,
       o.status AS status,
       o.created AS created,
       o.last_ddl_time AS last_altered
FROM all_objects o
WHERE o.object_type IN ('FUNCTION', 'PROCEDURE', 'PACKAGE') AND o.owner = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY 2, 3

desc.ko: Oracle은 사용자가 곧 스키마다. 보이는 사용자와 만든 날.
desc.en: In Oracle a user is a schema. Visible users and when they were created.

queries.body:
SELECT u.username AS schema_name,
       u.created AS created
FROM all_users u
ORDER BY u.username

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 시퀀스. last_value는 캐시만큼 앞선 값일 수 있다(last_number).
desc.en: Sequences in schema {{schema}}. last_value may be ahead by the cache size (last_number).

queries.body:
SELECT s.sequence_owner AS schema_name,
       s.sequence_name AS sequence_name,
       s.last_number AS last_value,
       s.min_value AS start_value,
       s.increment_by AS increment_by,
       s.max_value AS max_value,
       s.cycle_flag AS cycle
FROM all_sequences s
WHERE s.sequence_owner = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY 2

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}에서 코멘트가 비어 있는 테이블과 컬럼. 컬럼 칸이 비면 테이블 자체다.
desc.en: Tables and columns in schema {{schema}} with no comment. An empty column cell means the table itself.

queries.body:
SELECT c.owner AS schema_name,
       c.table_name AS table_name,
       NULL AS column_name
FROM all_tab_comments c
WHERE c.owner = '{{schema}}' AND c.comments IS NULL AND c.table_name NOT LIKE 'BIN$%'
UNION ALL
SELECT m.owner, m.table_name, m.column_name
FROM all_col_comments m
WHERE m.owner = '{{schema}}' AND m.comments IS NULL AND m.table_name NOT LIKE 'BIN$%'
ORDER BY 2, 3 NULLS FIRST

desc.ko: 테이블·인덱스·LOB 세그먼트를 크기 순으로 50개. dba_segments를 읽는다.
desc.en: The 50 largest table, index and LOB segments. Reads dba_segments.

queries.body:
SELECT *
FROM (SELECT s.owner AS schema_name,
             s.segment_name AS segment_name,
             s.segment_type AS segment_type,
             SUM(s.bytes) AS total_bytes
      FROM dba_segments s
      WHERE s.owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM')
      GROUP BY s.owner, s.segment_name, s.segment_type
      ORDER BY total_bytes DESC)
WHERE ROWNUM <= 50

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 테이블과 뷰, 코멘트. 행 수 추정은 「크기가 큰 테이블」·「테이블별 읽기·쓰기 활동」에 있다(사전 뷰를 한 쿼리에 묶으면 11g에서 느리다).
desc.en: Tables and views in schema {{schema}} with comments. Row estimates are in "Largest tables" and "Table activity" (joining dictionary views is slow on 11g).

queries.body:
SELECT c.owner AS schema_name,
       c.table_name AS table_name,
       LOWER(c.table_type) AS table_type,
       c.comments AS comments
FROM all_tab_comments c
WHERE c.owner = '{{schema}}' AND c.table_name NOT LIKE 'BIN$%'
ORDER BY c.table_name

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 뷰와 정의 SQL.
desc.en: Views in schema {{schema}} and their SQL definitions.

queries.body:
SELECT v.owner AS schema_name,
       v.view_name AS view_name,
       v.text AS definition
FROM all_views v
WHERE v.owner = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY v.view_name

desc.ko: 디스크를 읽지 않고 메모리에서 찾은 비율.
desc.en: The share of reads served from memory instead of disk.

queries.body:
SELECT ROUND(100 * (1 - phy.value / NULLIF(db.value + con.value, 0)), 2) AS hit_percent,
       db.value AS db_block_gets,
       con.value AS consistent_gets,
       phy.value AS physical_reads
FROM v$sysstat db
CROSS JOIN v$sysstat con
CROSS JOIN v$sysstat phy
WHERE db.name = 'db block gets' AND con.name = 'consistent gets' AND phy.name = 'physical reads'

desc.ko: 사용자·호스트별 연결 수와 그중 지금 일하는 연결 수.
desc.en: Connection counts per user and host, with how many are active.

queries.body:
SELECT s.username AS user_name,
       s.machine AS client_host,
       COUNT(*) AS connections,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active
FROM v$session s
WHERE s.type = 'USER'
GROUP BY s.username, s.machine
ORDER BY connections DESC

desc.ko: 테이블스페이스별 데이터 파일 크기와 남은 자리.
desc.en: Data file size and free space per tablespace.

queries.body:
SELECT d.tablespace_name AS tablespace_name,
       SUM(d.bytes) AS total_bytes,
       (SELECT SUM(f.bytes) FROM dba_free_space f WHERE f.tablespace_name = d.tablespace_name) AS free_bytes
FROM dba_data_files d
GROUP BY d.tablespace_name
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC

desc.ko: {{minutes}}분 넘게 돌고 있는 쿼리. {{minutes}}를 숫자로 바꿔 넣는다.
desc.en: Queries running longer than {{minutes}} minutes. Replace {{minutes}} with a number.

queries.body:
SELECT s.sid AS session_id,
       s.serial# AS serial_no,
       s.username AS user_name,
       s.status AS state,
       s.sql_exec_start AS query_started,
       s.last_call_et AS running_seconds,
       s.event AS wait_event,
       SUBSTR(q.sql_text, 1, 500) AS query_text
FROM v$session s
LEFT JOIN v$sql q ON q.sql_id = s.sql_id AND q.child_number = s.sql_child_number
WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND s.sid <> SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV', 'SID')
  AND s.last_call_et >= {{minutes}} * 60
ORDER BY s.last_call_et DESC

desc.ko: 메모리·연결·타임아웃 등 자주 보는 서버 설정값.
desc.en: Commonly checked server settings such as memory, connections and timeouts.

queries.body:
SELECT p.name AS setting_name,
       p.value AS value,
       p.description AS description
FROM v$parameter p
WHERE p.name IN ('sga_target', 'pga_aggregate_target', 'memory_target', 'processes', 'sessions', 'open_cursors',
                 'db_block_size', 'undo_retention', 'optimizer_mode', 'nls_language', 'nls_territory', 'compatible', 'cpu_count')
ORDER BY p.name

desc.ko: 연결된 세션 — 사용자·호스트·프로그램·상태·접속 시각·지금 쿼리 앞부분.
desc.en: Connected sessions with user, host, program, state, connect time and the start of the current query.

queries.body:
SELECT s.sid AS session_id,
       s.serial# AS serial_no,
       s.username AS user_name,
       s.machine AS client_host,
       s.program AS program,
       s.status AS state,
       s.logon_time AS connected_at,
       s.sql_exec_start AS query_started,
       s.event AS wait_event,
       s.blocking_session AS blocked_by,
       SUBSTR(q.sql_text, 1, 200) AS query_text
FROM v$session s
LEFT JOIN v$sql q ON q.sql_id = s.sql_id AND q.child_number = s.sql_child_number
WHERE s.type = 'USER'
ORDER BY s.logon_time

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 테이블별 행 수 추정·마지막 통계 수집과 그 뒤 바뀐 행 수(모니터링 정보가 내려온 만큼).
desc.en: Per-table row estimates, last statistics gathering and rows changed since (as far as monitoring info is flushed) in schema {{schema}}.

queries.body:
SELECT t.owner AS schema_name,
       t.table_name AS table_name,
       t.num_rows AS row_estimate,
       t.last_analyzed AS last_analyze,
       m.inserts AS inserted,
       m.updates AS updated,
       m.deletes AS deleted,
       m.timestamp AS modified_at
FROM all_tables t
LEFT JOIN all_tab_modifications m
       ON m.table_owner = t.owner AND m.table_name = t.table_name AND m.partition_name IS NULL
WHERE t.owner = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY t.table_name

desc.ko: 공유 풀에 남은 SQL 중 누적 실행 시간이 큰 20개.
desc.en: The 20 statements in the shared pool with the largest total elapsed time.

queries.body:
SELECT *
FROM (SELECT q.sql_id AS sql_id,
             q.executions AS calls,
             ROUND(q.elapsed_time / 1000) AS total_ms,
             ROUND(q.elapsed_time / NULLIF(q.executions, 0) / 1000, 2) AS mean_ms,
             q.rows_processed AS rows_returned,
             SUBSTR(q.sql_text, 1, 300) AS query_text
      FROM v$sqlarea q
      ORDER BY q.elapsed_time DESC)
WHERE ROWNUM <= 20

desc.ko: 사용자 {{user}}의 비밀번호를 {{password}}로 바꾼다.
desc.en: Changes the password of user {{user}} to {{password}}.

queries.body: ALTER USER {{user}} IDENTIFIED BY "{{password}}"

desc.ko: 사용자 {{user}}를 만들고 접속 권한(CREATE SESSION)을 준다. 두 문장 — 스크립트로 실행한다.
desc.en: Creates user {{user}} and grants CREATE SESSION. Two statements — run as a script.

queries.body:
CREATE USER {{user}} IDENTIFIED BY "{{password}}";
GRANT CREATE SESSION TO {{user}};

desc.ko: 사용자 {{user}}를 지운다. 가진 객체가 있으면 실패한다 — 객체까지 지우려면 CASCADE를 붙인다(되돌릴 수 없다).
desc.en: Drops user {{user}}. Fails while it owns objects — add CASCADE to drop them too (irreversible).

queries.body: DROP USER {{user}}

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 지금 테이블·뷰마다 SELECT를 준다(Oracle은 스키마 단위 GRANT가 없다). 나중에 만든 표는 다시 돌린다.
desc.en: Grants SELECT on every current table and view in schema {{schema}} (Oracle has no schema-level grant). Re-run for tables created later.

privilege.ko: GRANT ANY OBJECT PRIVILEGE 또는 스키마 주인
privilege.en: GRANT ANY OBJECT PRIVILEGE 또는 스키마 주인

desc.ko: 사용자와 계정 상태(OPEN·LOCKED·EXPIRED)·잠긴 날·만료일.
desc.en: Users with account status (OPEN, LOCKED, EXPIRED), lock date and expiry.

queries.body:
SELECT u.username AS user_name,
       u.account_status AS status,
       u.lock_date AS locked_at,
       u.expiry_date AS expires_at,
       u.created AS created,
       u.default_tablespace AS default_tablespace,
       u.profile AS profile
FROM dba_users u
ORDER BY u.username

desc.ko: 사용자 {{user}}가 더는 접속하지 못하게 한다. 이미 붙은 세션은 그대로다.
desc.en: Prevents user {{user}} from connecting. Existing sessions stay.

queries.body: ALTER USER {{user}} ACCOUNT LOCK

title.en: Who can do what on a table

desc.ko: 테이블 {{table}}에 권한을 받은 사용자와 그 권한.
desc.en: Users granted privileges on table {{table}} and what they can do.

queries.body:
SELECT t.grantee AS grantee,
       t.privilege AS privilege,
       t.grantable AS grantable,
       t.grantor AS grantor
FROM dba_tab_privs t
WHERE t.owner = '{{schema}}' AND t.table_name = '{{table}}'
ORDER BY 1, 2

desc.ko: 사용자 {{user}}가 스키마 {{schema}}에서 받은 SELECT를 표마다 되돌린다.
desc.en: Revokes every SELECT that user {{user}} holds on schema {{schema}}, table by table.

desc.ko: 잠근 사용자 {{user}}가 다시 접속할 수 있게 한다.
desc.en: Lets locked user {{user}} connect again.

queries.body: ALTER USER {{user}} ACCOUNT UNLOCK

desc.ko: 사용자 {{user}}가 가진 권한 — 시스템·롤·객체.
desc.en: Every privilege held by user {{user}} — system, role and object.

queries.body:
SELECT 'system' AS privilege_kind, p.privilege AS privilege, NULL AS object_name, p.admin_option AS grantable
FROM dba_sys_privs p
WHERE p.grantee = UPPER('{{user}}')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'role', r.granted_role, NULL, r.admin_option
FROM dba_role_privs r
WHERE r.grantee = UPPER('{{user}}')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'object', t.privilege, t.owner || '.' || t.table_name, t.grantable
FROM dba_tab_privs t
WHERE t.grantee = UPPER('{{user}}')
ORDER BY 1, 3, 2

desc.ko: 누가 누구를 기다리는지 한 줄씩 — 기다린 시간과 양쪽 쿼리. 막는 쪽 세션부터 본다.
desc.en: One row per wait showing who waits on whom, how long, and both queries. Start from the blocking session.

queries.body:
SELECT w.pid AS blocked_session,
       w.usename AS blocked_user,
       now() - w.query_start AS waiting_for,
       left(w.query, 200) AS blocked_query,
       b.pid AS blocking_session,
       b.usename AS blocking_user,
       b.state AS blocking_state,
       left(b.query, 200) AS blocking_query
FROM pg_stat_activity w
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(pg_blocking_pids(w.pid)) AS bp(pid)
JOIN pg_stat_activity b ON b.pid = bp.pid
ORDER BY waiting_for DESC

desc.ko: 세션 {{session_id}}의 지금 쿼리만 멈춘다. 세션(연결)은 남는다.
desc.en: Stops only the current query of session {{session_id}}. The session stays connected.

queries.body: SELECT pg_cancel_backend({{session_id}}) AS cancelled

desc.ko: 세션 {{session_id}}를 끊는다. 진행 중인 트랜잭션은 되돌려진다.
desc.en: Terminates session {{session_id}}. Its open transaction is rolled back.

queries.body: SELECT pg_terminate_backend({{session_id}}) AS terminated

desc.ko: 아직 얻지 못하고 기다리는 락 전부.
desc.en: Every lock request that is still waiting.

queries.body:
SELECT l.pid AS session_id,
       a.usename AS user_name,
       l.locktype AS lock_type,
       l.mode AS lock_mode,
       l.relation::regclass::text AS object_name,
       now() - a.query_start AS waiting_for,
       left(a.query, 200) AS query_text
FROM pg_locks l
JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid = l.pid
WHERE NOT l.granted
ORDER BY waiting_for DESC

desc.ko: 세션 {{session_id}}가 잡고 있거나 기다리는 락.
desc.en: Locks held or requested by session {{session_id}}.

queries.body:
SELECT l.locktype AS lock_type,
       l.mode AS lock_mode,
       l.granted AS granted,
       l.relation::regclass::text AS object_name,
       l.transactionid::text AS transaction_id
FROM pg_locks l
WHERE l.pid = {{session_id}}
ORDER BY l.granted, l.locktype

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 CHECK 제약과 조건식.
desc.en: Check constraints in schema {{schema}} with their conditions.

queries.body:
SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,
       c.relname AS table_name,
       con.conname AS constraint_name,
       pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) AS definition
FROM pg_constraint con
JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = con.conrelid
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE con.contype = 'c' AND n.nspname = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY 2, 3

title.en: Columns — name, type, null, default, comment

desc.ko: 테이블 {{table}}의 컬럼을 순서대로 보여 준다. 길이·정밀도·생성 열 여부도 함께.
desc.en: Columns of table {{table}} in order, with length, precision and generated-column info.

queries.body:
SELECT a.attnum AS ordinal,
       a.attname AS column_name,
       format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) AS data_type,
       ic.character_maximum_length AS max_length,
       ic.numeric_precision AS numeric_precision,
       ic.numeric_scale AS numeric_scale,
       CASE WHEN a.attnotnull THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END AS nullable,
       pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid) AS default_value,
       CASE WHEN a.attgenerated = 's' THEN 'stored'
            WHEN a.attidentity IN ('a', 'd') THEN 'identity' END AS generated_kind,
       col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum) AS comments
FROM pg_attribute a
JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = a.attrelid
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum
LEFT JOIN information_schema.columns ic
       ON ic.table_schema = n.nspname AND ic.table_name = t.relname AND ic.column_name = a.attname
WHERE n.nspname = '{{schema}}' AND t.relname = '{{table}}' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY a.attnum

desc.ko: 모든 스키마에서 이름에 {{pattern}}이 들어간 컬럼을 찾는다.
desc.en: Finds columns whose name contains {{pattern}} across all schemas.

queries.body:
SELECT c.table_schema AS schema_name,
       c.table_name AS table_name,
       c.column_name AS column_name,
       c.data_type AS data_type
FROM information_schema.columns c
WHERE c.column_name ILIKE '%{{pattern}}%'
  AND c.table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}가 참조하거나 참조당하는 외래 키와 갱신·삭제 규칙.
desc.en: Foreign keys referencing or referenced by schema {{schema}}, with update and delete rules.

queries.body:
SELECT cn.nspname AS schema_name,
       c.relname AS table_name,
       con.conname AS constraint_name,
       (SELECT string_agg(a.attname, ', ' ORDER BY k.ord)
          FROM unnest(con.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord)
          JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = con.conrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum) AS column_names,
       rn.nspname AS ref_schema,
       r.relname AS ref_table,
       (SELECT string_agg(a.attname, ', ' ORDER BY k.ord)
          FROM unnest(con.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord)
          JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = con.confrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum) AS ref_column_names,
       CASE con.confupdtype WHEN 'a' THEN 'NO ACTION' WHEN 'r' THEN 'RESTRICT' WHEN 'c' THEN 'CASCADE'
                            WHEN 'n' THEN 'SET NULL' WHEN 'd' THEN 'SET DEFAULT' END AS on_update,
       CASE con.confdeltype WHEN 'a' THEN 'NO ACTION' WHEN 'r' THEN 'RESTRICT' WHEN 'c' THEN 'CASCADE'
                            WHEN 'n' THEN 'SET NULL' WHEN 'd' THEN 'SET DEFAULT' END AS on_delete
FROM pg_constraint con
JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = con.conrelid
JOIN pg_namespace cn ON cn.oid = c.relnamespace
JOIN pg_class r ON r.oid = con.confrelid
JOIN pg_namespace rn ON rn.oid = r.relnamespace
WHERE con.contype = 'f' AND (cn.nspname = '{{schema}}' OR rn.nspname = '{{schema}}')
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 인덱스 — 고유 여부와 컬럼 순서.
desc.en: Indexes in schema {{schema}} with uniqueness and column order.

queries.body:
SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,
       t.relname AS table_name,
       i.relname AS index_name,
       CASE WHEN ix.indisunique THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_unique,
       CASE WHEN ix.indisprimary THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_primary,
       am.amname AS index_type,
       array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT pg_get_indexdef(ix.indexrelid, k, true)
                             FROM generate_series(1, ix.indnatts) AS k ORDER BY k), ', ') AS column_names
FROM pg_index ix
JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = ix.indexrelid
JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = ix.indrelid
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace
JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = i.relam
WHERE n.nspname = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY 2, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 PK·UK와 그 컬럼.
desc.en: Primary and unique keys in schema {{schema}} with their columns.

queries.body:
SELECT tc.table_schema AS schema_name,
       tc.table_name AS table_name,
       tc.constraint_name AS constraint_name,
       tc.constraint_type AS constraint_type,
       string_agg(k.column_name, ', ' ORDER BY k.ordinal_position) AS column_names
FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage k
  ON k.constraint_schema = tc.constraint_schema AND k.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name AND k.table_name = tc.table_name
WHERE tc.constraint_type IN ('PRIMARY KEY', 'UNIQUE') AND tc.table_schema = '{{schema}}'
GROUP BY tc.table_schema, tc.table_name, tc.constraint_name, tc.constraint_type
ORDER BY 2, 4, 3

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 함수·프로시저와 인자·반환 타입.
desc.en: Functions and procedures in schema {{schema}} with arguments and return type.

queries.body:
SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,
       p.proname AS routine_name,
       CASE p.prokind WHEN 'f' THEN 'function' WHEN 'p' THEN 'procedure'
                      WHEN 'a' THEN 'aggregate' WHEN 'w' THEN 'window' END AS routine_type,
       pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments,
       pg_get_function_result(p.oid) AS returns,
       l.lanname AS language
FROM pg_proc p
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid = p.prolang
WHERE n.nspname = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY 2, 4

desc.ko: 스키마와 소유자를 보여 준다.
desc.en: Lists schemas and their owners.

queries.body:
SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,
       pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner) AS owner,
       obj_description(n.oid, 'pg_namespace') AS comments
FROM pg_namespace n
WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\_%' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema'
ORDER BY n.nspname

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 시퀀스(또는 자동 증가) 현재값.
desc.en: Current values of sequences (or auto-increment) in schema {{schema}}.

queries.body:
SELECT s.schemaname AS schema_name,
       s.sequencename AS sequence_name,
       s.last_value AS last_value,
       s.start_value AS start_value,
       s.increment_by AS increment_by,
       s.max_value AS max_value,
       s.cycle AS cycle
FROM pg_sequences s
WHERE s.schemaname = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY 2

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}에서 코멘트가 비어 있는 테이블과 컬럼. 컬럼 칸이 비면 테이블 자체다.
desc.en: Tables and columns in schema {{schema}} with no comment. An empty column cell means the table itself.

queries.body:
SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,
       c.relname AS table_name,
       NULL::text AS column_name
FROM pg_class c
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm') AND n.nspname = '{{schema}}'
  AND obj_description(c.oid, 'pg_class') IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname::text
FROM pg_attribute a
JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm') AND n.nspname = '{{schema}}'
  AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND col_description(c.oid, a.attnum) IS NULL
ORDER BY 2, 3 NULLS FIRST

desc.ko: 데이터·인덱스 크기 합이 큰 순서로 50개.
desc.en: The 50 largest tables by data plus index size.

queries.body:
SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,
       c.relname AS table_name,
       pg_table_size(c.oid) AS data_bytes,
       pg_indexes_size(c.oid) AS index_bytes,
       pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS total_bytes,
       pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)) AS total_pretty
FROM pg_class c
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'm')
  AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\_toast%'
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC
LIMIT 50

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 테이블과 뷰 — 종류·행 수 추정·코멘트.
desc.en: Tables and views in schema {{schema}} with type, estimated rows and comment.

queries.body:
SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,
       c.relname AS table_name,
       CASE c.relkind WHEN 'r' THEN 'table' WHEN 'p' THEN 'partitioned table' WHEN 'v' THEN 'view'
                      WHEN 'm' THEN 'materialized view' WHEN 'f' THEN 'foreign table' END AS table_type,
       c.reltuples::bigint AS row_estimate,
       obj_description(c.oid, 'pg_class') AS comments
FROM pg_class c
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'f') AND n.nspname = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY c.relname

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 뷰와 정의 SQL.
desc.en: Views in schema {{schema}} and their SQL definitions.

queries.body:
SELECT v.schemaname AS schema_name,
       v.viewname AS view_name,
       v.definition AS definition
FROM pg_views v
WHERE v.schemaname = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY v.viewname

desc.ko: 디스크를 읽지 않고 메모리에서 찾은 비율.
desc.en: The share of reads served from memory instead of disk.

queries.body:
SELECT d.datname AS database_name,
       d.blks_hit AS cache_hits,
       d.blks_read AS disk_reads,
       round(100.0 * d.blks_hit / nullif(d.blks_hit + d.blks_read, 0), 2) AS hit_percent
FROM pg_stat_database d
WHERE d.datname IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.datname

desc.ko: 사용자·호스트별 연결 수와 그중 지금 일하는 연결 수.
desc.en: Connection counts per user and host, with how many are active.

queries.body:
SELECT a.usename AS user_name,
       a.client_addr::text AS client_host,
       a.datname AS database_name,
       count(*) AS connections,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state = 'active') AS active
FROM pg_stat_activity a
WHERE a.backend_type = 'client backend'
GROUP BY a.usename, a.client_addr::text, a.datname
ORDER BY connections DESC

desc.ko: 데이터베이스(또는 테이블스페이스)별 크기.
desc.en: Size per database (or tablespace).

queries.body:
SELECT d.datname AS database_name,
       pg_database_size(d.datname) AS total_bytes,
       pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(d.datname)) AS total_pretty
FROM pg_database d
WHERE d.datallowconn
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC

desc.ko: {{minutes}}분 넘게 돌고 있는 쿼리. {{minutes}}를 숫자로 바꿔 넣는다.
desc.en: Queries running longer than {{minutes}} minutes. Replace {{minutes}} with a number.

queries.body:
SELECT a.pid AS session_id,
       a.usename AS user_name,
       a.state AS state,
       now() - a.query_start AS running_for,
       a.wait_event AS wait_event,
       left(a.query, 500) AS query_text
FROM pg_stat_activity a
WHERE a.state <> 'idle'
  AND a.pid <> pg_backend_pid()
  AND a.query_start < now() - make_interval(mins => {{minutes}})
ORDER BY a.query_start

desc.ko: 이 서버(주 서버)에 붙은 복제 서버와 지연. 복제를 안 쓰면 행이 없다.
desc.en: Replicas attached to this (primary) server and their lag. Returns nothing without replication.

queries.body:
SELECT r.pid AS session_id,
       r.usename AS user_name,
       r.application_name AS program,
       r.client_addr::text AS client_host,
       r.state AS state,
       r.sync_state AS sync_state,
       r.sent_lsn::text AS sent_lsn,
       r.replay_lsn::text AS replay_lsn,
       r.replay_lag AS replay_lag
FROM pg_stat_replication r
ORDER BY r.application_name

desc.ko: 메모리·연결·타임아웃 등 자주 보는 서버 설정값.
desc.en: Commonly checked server settings such as memory, connections and timeouts.

queries.body:
SELECT s.name AS setting_name,
       s.setting AS value,
       s.unit AS unit,
       s.source AS source,
       s.short_desc AS description
FROM pg_settings s
WHERE s.name IN ('max_connections', 'shared_buffers', 'work_mem', 'maintenance_work_mem', 'effective_cache_size',
                 'wal_level', 'max_wal_size', 'checkpoint_timeout', 'autovacuum', 'statement_timeout', 'lock_timeout',
                 'idle_in_transaction_session_timeout', 'log_min_duration_statement', 'timezone', 'server_encoding',
                 'max_parallel_workers')
ORDER BY s.name

desc.ko: 연결된 세션 — 사용자·호스트·프로그램·상태·접속 시각·지금 쿼리 앞부분.
desc.en: Connected sessions with user, host, program, state, connect time and the start of the current query.

queries.body:
SELECT a.pid AS session_id,
       a.usename AS user_name,
       a.client_addr::text AS client_host,
       a.application_name AS program,
       a.state AS state,
       a.backend_start AS connected_at,
       a.query_start AS query_started,
       a.wait_event_type AS wait_type,
       a.wait_event AS wait_event,
       left(a.query, 200) AS query_text
FROM pg_stat_activity a
WHERE a.backend_type = 'client backend'
ORDER BY a.backend_start

desc.ko: 스키마 {{schema}}의 테이블별 읽기·쓰기 횟수와 마지막 통계·정리 시각.
desc.en: Per-table read and write counts in schema {{schema}} with last statistics and maintenance times.

queries.body:
SELECT s.schemaname AS schema_name,
       s.relname AS table_name,
       s.seq_scan AS seq_scans,
       s.idx_scan AS index_scans,
       s.n_tup_ins AS inserted,
       s.n_tup_upd AS updated,
       s.n_tup_del AS deleted,
       s.n_live_tup AS live_rows,
       s.n_dead_tup AS dead_rows,
       s.last_vacuum AS last_vacuum,
       s.last_autovacuum AS last_autovacuum,
       s.last_analyze AS last_analyze,
       s.last_autoanalyze AS last_autoanalyze
FROM pg_stat_user_tables s
WHERE s.schemaname = '{{schema}}'
ORDER BY s.relname

desc.ko: 서버가 모아 둔 쿼리 통계에서 누적 실행 시간이 큰 순서로 20개.
desc.en: The 20 statements with the largest total execution time from server statistics.

queries.body:
SELECT s.calls AS calls,
       round(s.total_exec_time::numeric, 1) AS total_ms,
       round(s.mean_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS mean_ms,
       s.rows AS rows_returned,
       left(s.query, 300) AS query_text
FROM pg_stat_statements s
ORDER BY s.total_exec_time DESC
LIMIT 20

desc.ko: 사용자 {{user}}의 비밀번호를 {{password}}로 바꾼다.
desc.en: Changes the password of user {{user}} to {{password}}.

queries.body: ALTER ROLE {{user}} PASSWORD '{{password}}'

desc.ko: {{user}}·{{password}}를 바꿔 넣고 실행한다.
desc.en: Replace {{user}} and {{password}}, then run.

queries.body: CREATE ROLE {{user}} LOGIN PASSWORD '{{password}}'

desc.ko: 사용자 {{user}}를 지운다. 가진 객체·권한이 남아 있으면 실패한다 — 먼저 회수하거나 옮긴다.
desc.en: Drops user {{user}}. Fails while the user still owns objects or holds grants — revoke or reassign first.

queries.body: DROP ROLE {{user}}

desc.ko: 롤 {{user}}에게 스키마 {{schema}}의 지금 테이블과 앞으로 만들 테이블 읽기 권한을 준다. 세 문장 — 스크립트로 실행한다.
desc.en: Grants role {{user}} read on current and future tables in schema {{schema}}. Three statements — run as a script.

desc.ko: 롤(로그인할 수 있으면 사용자)과 슈퍼유저·만료·속한 롤.
desc.en: Roles (users when they can log in) with superuser flag, expiry and memberships.

queries.body:
SELECT r.rolname AS user_name,
       r.rolcanlogin AS can_login,
       r.rolsuper AS is_superuser,
       r.rolcreaterole AS can_create_role,
       r.rolcreatedb AS can_create_db,
       r.rolvaliduntil AS valid_until,
       r.rolconnlimit AS connection_limit,
       array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT m.rolname
                             FROM pg_auth_members am
                             JOIN pg_roles m ON m.oid = am.roleid
                             WHERE am.member = r.oid
                             ORDER BY 1), ', ') AS member_of
FROM pg_roles r
WHERE r.rolname NOT LIKE 'pg\_%'
ORDER BY r.rolname

desc.ko: 사용자 {{user}}가 더는 접속하지 못하게 한다. 이미 붙은 세션은 그대로다.
desc.en: Prevents user {{user}} from connecting. Existing sessions stay.

queries.body: ALTER ROLE {{user}} NOLOGIN

title.en: Who can do what on a table

desc.ko: 테이블 {{table}}에 권한을 받은 사용자와 그 권한.
desc.en: Users granted privileges on table {{table}} and what they can do.

queries.body:
SELECT g.grantee AS grantee,
       g.table_schema AS schema_name,
       g.table_name AS object_name,
       string_agg(g.privilege_type, ', ' ORDER BY g.privilege_type) AS privileges,
       bool_or(g.is_grantable = 'YES') AS grantable
FROM information_schema.role_table_grants g
WHERE g.table_schema = '{{schema}}' AND g.table_name = '{{table}}'
GROUP BY g.grantee, g.table_schema, g.table_name
ORDER BY 1

desc.ko: 「스키마 읽기 권한 주기」로 준 권한을 되돌린다.
desc.en: Reverts the grant made by "Grant read on a schema".

desc.ko: 잠근 사용자 {{user}}가 다시 접속할 수 있게 한다.
desc.en: Lets locked user {{user}} connect again.

queries.body: ALTER ROLE {{user}} LOGIN

desc.ko: 롤 {{user}}가 받은 테이블 권한과 스키마 권한(USAGE·CREATE).
desc.en: Table privileges and schema privileges (USAGE, CREATE) held by role {{user}}.

queries.body:
SELECT 'table' AS object_type,
       g.table_schema AS schema_name,
       g.table_name AS object_name,
       string_agg(g.privilege_type, ', ' ORDER BY g.privilege_type) AS privileges,
       g.grantor AS grantor
FROM information_schema.role_table_grants g
WHERE g.grantee = '{{user}}'
GROUP BY g.table_schema, g.table_name, g.grantor
UNION ALL
SELECT 'schema',
       n.nspname,
       NULL,
       concat_ws(', ',
                 CASE WHEN has_schema_privilege('{{user}}', n.oid, 'USAGE') THEN 'USAGE' END,
                 CASE WHEN has_schema_privilege('{{user}}', n.oid, 'CREATE') THEN 'CREATE' END),
       NULL
FROM pg_namespace n
WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\_%' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema'
  AND (has_schema_privilege('{{user}}', n.oid, 'USAGE') OR has_schema_privilege('{{user}}', n.oid, 'CREATE'))
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

desc.ko: 테이블 {{table}}의 컬럼을 순서대로 — PK 위치와 생성 열 여부도 함께. SQLite는 컬럼 코멘트가 없다.
desc.en: Columns of table {{table}} in order, with primary-key position and generated-column info. SQLite has no column comments.

queries.body:
SELECT c.cid + 1 AS ordinal,
       c.name AS column_name,
       c.type AS data_type,
       CASE WHEN c."notnull" = 1 THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END AS nullable,
       c.dflt_value AS default_value,
       c.pk AS pk_position,
       CASE c.hidden WHEN 2 THEN 'virtual' WHEN 3 THEN 'stored' END AS generated_kind
FROM pragma_table_xinfo('{{table}}') AS c
ORDER BY c.cid

desc.ko: 모든 테이블에서 이름에 {{pattern}}이 들어간 컬럼을 찾는다.
desc.en: Finds columns whose name contains {{pattern}} in every table.

queries.body:
SELECT m.name AS table_name,
       c.name AS column_name,
       c.type AS data_type
FROM sqlite_master AS m
JOIN pragma_table_info(m.name) AS c
WHERE m.type = 'table' AND c.name LIKE '%{{pattern}}%'
ORDER BY 1, 2

desc.ko: 모든 테이블의 외래 키 — 참조 테이블·컬럼과 갱신·삭제 규칙. 참조당하는 쪽은 ref_table 칸으로 찾는다.
desc.en: Foreign keys of every table with referenced table, columns and rules. Filter ref_table to see the referenced side.

queries.body:
SELECT m.name AS table_name,
       f.id AS constraint_id,
       group_concat(f."from", ', ') AS column_names,
       f."table" AS ref_table,
       group_concat(f."to", ', ') AS ref_column_names,
       f.on_update AS on_update,
       f.on_delete AS on_delete
FROM sqlite_master AS m
JOIN pragma_foreign_key_list(m.name) AS f
WHERE m.type = 'table'
GROUP BY m.name, f.id
ORDER BY 1, 2

desc.ko: 모든 테이블의 인덱스 — 고유 여부·만든 까닭(c 직접·u UNIQUE·pk 기본 키)·컬럼.
desc.en: Indexes of every table with uniqueness, origin (c = created, u = UNIQUE, pk = primary key) and columns.

queries.body:
SELECT m.name AS table_name,
       il.name AS index_name,
       CASE WHEN il."unique" = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_unique,
       CASE il.origin WHEN 'pk' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_primary,
       il.origin AS origin,
       (SELECT group_concat(ii.name, ', ') FROM pragma_index_info(il.name) AS ii) AS column_names
FROM sqlite_master AS m
JOIN pragma_index_list(m.name) AS il
WHERE m.type = 'table'
ORDER BY 1, 2

desc.ko: 모든 테이블의 PK와 UNIQUE 제약, 그 컬럼.
desc.en: Primary keys and UNIQUE constraints of every table with their columns.

queries.body:
SELECT m.name AS table_name,
       NULL AS constraint_name,
       'PRIMARY KEY' AS constraint_type,
       group_concat(c.name, ', ') AS column_names
FROM sqlite_master AS m
JOIN pragma_table_info(m.name) AS c
WHERE m.type = 'table' AND c.pk > 0
GROUP BY m.name
UNION ALL
SELECT m.name,
       il.name,
       'UNIQUE',
       (SELECT group_concat(ii.name, ', ') FROM pragma_index_info(il.name) AS ii)
FROM sqlite_master AS m
JOIN pragma_index_list(m.name) AS il
WHERE m.type = 'table' AND il."unique" = 1 AND il.origin = 'u'
ORDER BY 1, 3

desc.ko: main과 ATTACH한 데이터베이스, 그 파일 경로. SQLite는 소유자가 없다.
desc.en: The main database and attached ones with their file paths. SQLite has no owners.

queries.body:
SELECT d.name AS schema_name,
       d.file AS file_path
FROM pragma_database_list AS d
ORDER BY d.seq

desc.ko: AUTOINCREMENT 테이블의 마지막 값. 그런 테이블이 하나도 없으면 sqlite_sequence가 없어 오류가 난다.
desc.en: Last values of AUTOINCREMENT tables. Fails when no such table exists because sqlite_sequence is missing.

queries.body:
SELECT s.name AS table_name,
       s.seq AS last_value
FROM sqlite_sequence AS s
ORDER BY s.name

desc.ko: 테이블·인덱스별로 차지한 페이지 크기 상위 50. dbstat 가상 테이블을 쓴다(DB Client의 SQLite에는 켜져 있다).
desc.en: Top 50 tables and indexes by page bytes. Uses the dbstat virtual table (enabled in the DB Client SQLite build).

queries.body:
SELECT s.name AS table_name,
       SUM(s.pgsize) AS total_bytes,
       COUNT(*) AS pages
FROM dbstat AS s
GROUP BY s.name
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC
LIMIT 50

desc.ko: 모든 스키마의 테이블과 뷰 — 종류·컬럼 수·STRICT 여부. SQLite는 행 수 추정과 코멘트가 없다.
desc.en: Tables and views in every schema with type, column count and STRICT flag. SQLite keeps no row estimates or comments.

queries.body:
SELECT t.schema AS schema_name,
       t.name AS table_name,
       t.type AS table_type,
       t.ncol AS column_count,
       t.strict AS strict
FROM pragma_table_list AS t
WHERE t.name NOT LIKE 'sqlite\_%' ESCAPE '\'
ORDER BY t.schema, t.name

desc.ko: 뷰와 만든 SQL.
desc.en: Views and the SQL that created them.

queries.body:
SELECT m.name AS view_name,
       m.sql AS definition
FROM sqlite_master AS m
WHERE m.type = 'view'
ORDER BY m.name

desc.ko: 데이터베이스 파일 크기와 비어 있는 페이지 크기(VACUUM으로 돌려받을 수 있는 자리).
desc.en: Database file size and free page bytes (reclaimable with VACUUM).

queries.body:
SELECT c.page_count * s.page_size AS total_bytes,
       f.freelist_count * s.page_size AS free_bytes,
       c.page_count AS pages,
       s.page_size AS page_size
FROM pragma_page_count AS c, pragma_page_size AS s, pragma_freelist_count AS f

desc.ko: 저널 모드·외래 키 검사·동기화 수준 등 이 연결의 PRAGMA 값.
desc.en: PRAGMA values of this connection such as journal mode, foreign keys and synchronous.

queries.body:
SELECT 'journal_mode' AS setting_name, j.journal_mode AS value FROM pragma_journal_mode AS j
UNION ALL SELECT 'foreign_keys', k.foreign_keys FROM pragma_foreign_keys AS k
UNION ALL SELECT 'synchronous', y.synchronous FROM pragma_synchronous AS y
UNION ALL SELECT 'busy_timeout', b.timeout FROM pragma_busy_timeout AS b
UNION ALL SELECT 'auto_vacuum', a.auto_vacuum FROM pragma_auto_vacuum AS a
UNION ALL SELECT 'encoding', e.encoding FROM pragma_encoding AS e
UNION ALL SELECT 'sqlite_version', sqlite_version()
